content.content:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("/content/assets/9e2529a85d9a7bf0bd91.csv")

df.drop('state', axis=1, inplace=True)
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format="%d.%m.%y")
df['month'] = df['date'].dt.month
df['day'] = df['date'].dt.day
df.set_index('day', inplace=True)

df = df[df['month']==6]

df[['cases', 'deaths']].plot(kind="line", legend=True)
plt.xlabel('Days in June')
plt.ylabel('Number')
plt.savefig('output/plot.png')

content.text: 默认情况下，pandas选择索引名称作为**xlabel**，而对于**ylabel**则留空。

By default, pandas select the index name as xlabel, while leaving it empty for ylabel.

The [b]suptitle[/b]() function can be used to set a plot title:[code format="py" codeId="3252"]plt.suptitle("COVID-19 in June") [/code]
We can also change the colors used in the plot by setting the [b]color[/b] attribute. It accepts a list of color hexes.

For example, let's set the cases to blue, deaths to red colors[b]:[/b] [code format="py" codeId="3253"]df[['cases', 'deaths']].plot(kind="area",
   legend=True, 
   stacked=False, 
   color=['#1970E7', '#E73E19']) [/code] [img id="4570" width="100%"] 
[note]These attributes work for almost all chart types.[/note]

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("/content/assets/9e2529a85d9a7bf0bd91.csv")

df.drop('state', axis=1, inplace=True)
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format="%d.%m.%y")
df['month'] = df['date'].dt.month
df['day'] = df['date'].dt.day
df.set_index('day', inplace=True)

df = df[df['month']==6]

df[['cases', 'deaths']].plot(kind="area", legend=True)
plt.xlabel('Days in June')
plt.ylabel('Number')
plt.suptitle("COVID-19 in June")
plt.savefig('output/plot.png')

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("/content/assets/9e2529a85d9a7bf0bd91.csv")

df.drop('state', axis=1, inplace=True)
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format="%d.%m.%y")
df['month'] = df['date'].dt.month
df['day'] = df['date'].dt.day
df.set_index('day', inplace=True)

df = df[df['month']==6]

df[['cases', 'deaths']].plot(kind="area", legend=True, stacked=False, color=['#1970E7', '#E73E19'])
plt.xlabel('Days in June')
plt.ylabel('Number')
plt.suptitle("COVID-19 in June")
plt.savefig('output/plot.png')
